name: e-Plikt
description: Exposes published node and media entities as an RSS 2.0 feed formatted for legal-deposit (mandatory delivery) to the National Library of Sweden, via pluggable source plugins.
project_description: e-Plikt provides an RSS export tailored to Swedish legal-deposit (e-plikt / mandatory delivery) requirements. It publishes two feeds, /eplikt/all and /eplikt/weekly, that list published entities collected by enabled source plugins. Two source plugins ship out of the box: Node and Media. The feed emits Dublin Core metadata (publisher, access rights, format) and, for media items, a media:content download link resolved through the Media entity download module, following the National Library of Sweden RSS delivery specification. Site builders configure a publisher identifier, default access rights and the set of source plugins (with per-source bundle selection) at /admin/config/services/eplikt. Developers can add their own source plugins by extending EpliktSourceBase and implementing the EpliktSource plugin type.
